mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without regime conditions.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.5% indicates severe labor market deterioration that triggers risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 8.5%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate and unemployment rate signal monetary tightening coinciding with labor market weakness, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of instances when both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE rise, or the Rank IC for the interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In early-cycle expansion regimes, rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strengthening consumer demand and business investment, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of instances during early-cycle expansion when HOUST rises, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in industrial production (INDPRO) reflects robust manufacturing output and supply chain strength, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO rises, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation that prompts central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes, strong non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS > 200k) signals labor market recovery that boosts consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 200 and UNRATE > 8.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in retail sales (RSAFS) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust consumer demand and supply chain strength, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through joint market signals.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of instances when both RSAFS and INDPRO rise, or the Rank IC for the interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
